description: This PHP script initializes the OrangeHRM database by deleting existing employee and user data and populating it with a predefined set of 110 employees and their corresponding user accounts, including an admin account. It sets up database connections, truncates relevant tables, and inserts employee and user records with specific data, primarily for testing or initial setup purposes.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: Class responsible for holding database configuration details such as host, user, password, database name, and port.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the Conf class, initializes database configuration parameters.
